describe.description: A single chimeric quadruped is shown in right-facing side view standing on a small patch of bare earth with sparse tufts of grass and small pebbles. The animal has a pale pink, wrinkled, soft-skinned ventral body, head, and limbs resembling an amphibian, while its entire dorsal surface from just behind the head to the tip of its long tapering tail is covered in overlapping large brown keratinous scales. The head is broad and rounded with large prominent eyes and a slightly smiling mouth, and six feathery pink external gills protrude from the sides of the neck behind the head. It stands on four short stout limbs with clawed feet, the body held low to the ground, the tail extending straight back to the left.

describe.description: A stout four-legged creature shown in side view facing right, with a pale pink, broad rounded head and pale pink wrinkled skin on its underside and limbs, and overlapping brown armor scales covering its arched back and the top of its long tapering tail. The head has large round dark eyes with blue rims, a wide slightly smiling mouth, and dark speckling on top, with multiple pink stalked feathery external gills with red filaments projecting from the sides just behind the head. The body is low to the ground on four short thick limbs with clawed toes, and the tail extends to the left, pink and ringed underneath and scaled on top.
